defect_summary: The producer session counted one remaining merge while pull request #73 was CONFLICTING.
unsuitable_process: The release skill allows a remaining-merge count without a live GitHub mergeable observation. ADR 0038 forbids memory counts; ADR 0049 requires the next stop from planner or observed facts, not a guessed click tally.
climb_steps: No gh pr view --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus before that sentence.
Release skill has no mergeability probe.
ADR 0038 / ADR 0049: process must quote live observations, not remembered counts.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
